elephant-birds-vanish-madagascar.research_focus: Aepyornis, the elephant bird of Madagascar, and its giant eggs, in the centuries after people settled the island
elephant-birds-vanish-madagascar.scene: A towering flightless bird, far taller than a man, with a long neck, a heavy body of shaggy plumage and thick legs, stands in dry Madagascan scrub beside a nest holding one enormous egg; a lone human figure watches from the edge of the trees for scale.

moa-extinct-new-zealand.research_focus: the giant moa of New Zealand and the early Polynesian settlers who hunted them
moa-extinct-new-zealand.scene: A giant wingless moa, much taller than a person, strides through a misty New Zealand podocarp forest while hunters with spears crouch in the ferns; the moa has no wings at all, not an ostrich or emu.

stellers-sea-cow-hunted-out.research_focus: Steller's sea cow in the kelp beds of the Commander Islands in the Bering Sea, and the eighteenth-century fur hunters
stellers-sea-cow-hunted-out.scene: A huge, rounded sea cow with a small head and forked tail floats among kelp in a cold northern bay while a small wooden boat of eighteenth-century hunters closes in; non-graphic.

last-great-auks-killed.research_focus: the great auk and the rocky islet of Eldey off Iceland in the 1840s
last-great-auks-killed.scene: Two upright, penguin-like seabirds with heavy hooked bills stand on a wave-battered rock skerry as a rowing boat of fishermen pulls alongside under a stormy northern sky; non-graphic.

last-cape-lion-shot.research_focus: the Cape lion of South Africa's southern tip and nineteenth-century Cape hunters
last-cape-lion-shot.scene: A great lion with a heavy, shaggy mane stands on a rocky ridge in the Cape fynbos, looking back at a distant ox wagon and mounted hunters with long rifles.

tasmanian-emu-extinct.research_focus: the Tasmanian emu, a smaller island emu, and early colonial Tasmania
tasmanian-emu-extinct.scene: A small emu, shaggy and long-legged, picks its way across open Tasmanian grassland at dusk while a settler's hut and rail fence stand in the distance.

falkland-islands-wolf-extinct.research_focus: the warrah, the Falkland Islands wolf, and the islands' nineteenth-century sheep farming
falkland-islands-wolf-extinct.scene: A fox-like wild dog with a thick coat and a bushy tail stands on windswept tussock grass of a treeless island, sheep and a lone farmhouse in the distance.

stephens-island-wren-extinct.research_focus: Lyall's wren on Stephens Island, New Zealand, and the lighthouse built there in the 1890s
stephens-island-wren-extinct.scene: A tiny, round, almost tailless wren creeps among rocks at the foot of a lighthouse on a steep island while a cat crouches in the grass nearby, watching it.

rocky-mountain-locust-extinct.research_focus: the Rocky Mountain locust swarms over the nineteenth-century American Great Plains
rocky-mountain-locust-extinct.scene: A single locust rests on a wheat stalk in the foreground, while behind it an empty prairie sky stretches over a sod homestead where once vast swarms darkened the plains.

huia-last-seen.research_focus: the huia of New Zealand's North Island forests, with its long curved bill and prized tail feathers
huia-last-seen.scene: A pair of huia perch on a mossy branch in a dense New Zealand forest, the female's long, deeply curved bill beside the male's short straight one, their long tails fanned.

last-carolina-parakeet-dies.research_focus: the Carolina parakeet and the Cincinnati Zoo aviary in the 1910s
last-carolina-parakeet-dies.scene: A single small parrot sits alone on a perch in an empty early-twentieth-century zoo aviary of iron and glass, its flock's perches bare around it.

last-wild-barbary-lion-shot.research_focus: the Barbary lion of the Atlas Mountains in Morocco in the early twentieth century
last-wild-barbary-lion-shot.scene: A massive lion with a heavy mane that runs down its belly stands among cedars on a rocky Atlas mountainside, a hunter's silhouette far below on the trail.

last-heath-hen-booming-ben.research_focus: the heath hen on Martha's Vineyard and the scrub oak plains in the early 1930s
last-heath-hen-booming-ben.scene: A lone grouse-like male bird with inflated neck sacs and raised neck feathers calls from a clearing in scrub oak at dawn, with no other bird anywhere around him.

xerces-blue-butterfly-extinct.research_focus: the Xerces blue butterfly in the coastal sand dunes of the San Francisco peninsula, and the city's spread over them
xerces-blue-butterfly-extinct.scene: A small butterfly with spotted wings rests on a lupine flower in a coastal sand dune, while houses and streets press in at the edge of the dunes behind.

caribbean-monk-seal-last-sighted.research_focus: the Caribbean monk seal and the remote cays and banks of the western Caribbean
caribbean-monk-seal-last-sighted.scene: A lone monk seal lies on a small sandy cay in a calm sea under a wide tropical sky, the horizon empty in every direction.

caspian-tiger-extinct.research_focus: the Caspian tiger in the riverine tugai forests of Iran and Central Asia
caspian-tiger-extinct.scene: A large, long-legged tiger with a thick winter coat moves through tall reeds and poplar thickets along a river, half hidden, as if fading into the reeds.

javan-tiger-last-recorded.research_focus: the Javan tiger and the forests of Meru Betiri in eastern Java
javan-tiger-last-recorded.scene: A small, narrow-striped tiger stands at the edge of a dense rainforest, looking out across newly cleared farmland and terraced fields that end at the trees.

dusky-seaside-sparrow-last-dies.research_focus: the dusky seaside sparrow of Florida's Merritt Island and St Johns River marshes
dusky-seaside-sparrow-last-dies.scene: A small, streaked sparrow with a band on one leg perches on a single marsh grass stem inside a simple aviary cage, the open salt marsh visible beyond the mesh.

golden-toad-last-seen.research_focus: the golden toad of the Monteverde cloud forest in Costa Rica
golden-toad-last-seen.scene: A small, smooth-skinned toad sits alone on wet moss beside a forest pool in a misty cloud forest, glistening among the wet leaves; just one toad.

celia-last-pyrenean-ibex-dies.research_focus: the Pyrenean ibex, or bucardo, in Ordesa National Park in the Spanish Pyrenees
celia-last-pyrenean-ibex-dies.scene: A lone female wild goat with short curved horns stands on a steep rocky ledge in the Pyrenees beneath a large, leaning fir tree, mountains in mist behind her.

baiji-functionally-extinct.research_focus: the baiji, the Yangtze river dolphin, and the busy river of the 2000s
baiji-functionally-extinct.scene: A survey boat with observers holding binoculars sweeps a wide, murky river crowded with cargo barges, while beneath the surface a long-beaked river dolphin glides as a faint shadow.

lonesome-george-dies.research_focus: Lonesome George, the Pinta Island giant tortoise, at the Charles Darwin Research Station on Santa Cruz in the Galapagos
lonesome-george-dies.scene: A single ancient giant tortoise with a saddle-shaped shell stretches its long neck up beside a pond in a Galapagos enclosure among cacti and volcanic rock, alone.

ivory-billed-woodpecker-proposed-extinct.research_focus: the ivory-billed woodpecker in the bottomland swamp forests of the American South
ivory-billed-woodpecker-proposed-extinct.scene: A large crested woodpecker with a long ivory bill clings to a dead cypress trunk in a flooded swamp forest, half hidden in shadow as if glimpsed and not quite seen.

chinese-paddlefish-declared-extinct.research_focus: the Chinese paddlefish of the Yangtze, with its long sword-like snout
chinese-paddlefish-declared-extinct.scene: A huge, ancient-looking fish with a long, pointed, sword-like snout swims through murky river water, alone, its outline fading into the gloom.
